title: They Both Love Him: Can His Heart Endure?
excerpt: Two women. One husband. One home. Behind closed doors, hearts are slowly breaking, until one twist changes everything.
description: Two women. One husband. One home. But inside that home, emotions are running deeper than anyone can see.

If you love intense family drama, jealousy, and deep emotional stories, this is for you. Ahmad is trying his best, Aisha is hiding her tears, and Sumayah's journey will completely shock you. Just when you think it's over, a massive twist changes everything.
features: A story built around jealousy, loyalty, and quiet sacrifice
A twist that reframes everything that came before it
benefits: An emotional, character-driven read from start to finish
Perfect for readers who love layered family drama
